scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,worker,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/worker" "npm run dev -w apps/admin"
scripts.demo: npm run seed && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/admin
